title: partnerships-marketplace-daily-notes-jordan-3
content:
Daily scratchpad - partnerships / marketplace (quick notes, next steps, checklists)

2026-03-03
- Morning sync with Ashley (10:00) — recap: onboarding timeline, SLA ask from Partner A, sample API keys inbound.
- Quick goals for the day: follow up on SDK issue, confirm data residency for EU partners, update integration checklist with caching guidance.

Partner: Partner A (conversation last week)
- Needs: dedicated onboarding timeline + legal review window (asked for 4 weeks).
- Next steps:
  - [ ] Send updated onboarding timeline (include 2-week recommended opt-in for beta). assigned: Jordan. target: 2026-03-05
  - [ ] Confirm EU data residency option (ask infra & security). ticket: MP-218. owner: Samir.
  - [ ] Share sandbox credentials + README (attach SDK snippet). in progress: Ashley to send by EOD.

Partner: Integrator Beta
- Integration checklist quick status:
  - auth: API key generation — done
  - rate limits: review defaults — pending (need expected TPS from partner)
  - embeddings: they want local hashing option — research quantization implications (ask applied-ml)
  - prefix caching guidance: add note about 1k token warm-up

Immediate blockers:
- Legal requested sample DPA — legal has a backlog. Action: ping legal (Cara). TODO: escalate if no reply by 3/6.
- SDK bug: examples/py client throws 401 for refresh tokens. Repo PR: #91 (review requested).

Notes for integration checklist (to add/update)
- Add section: recommended batching settings for marketplace partners (low-latency vs throughput). short table to include example batch sizes and latency estimates.
- Add section: verification steps for private deployments (VPC, KMS keys) — include required config keys.
- Add step: confirm fallback model variants for quota spikes. guidance: prefer smaller quantized variant for cost-sensitive partners.

Meeting prep: Partner B onboarding (3/4)
- Agenda draft:
  - intro + timeline (5m)
  - technical walkthrough (20m) — show SDK, sandbox, metrics dashboard
  - rollout options (10m) — hosted vs dedicated vs private
  - legal / compliance Qs (10m)
- Prep items:
  - bring sample screenshots of dashboard latency/cost breakdown (console team).
  - prepare canned answers re: GDPR / EU data residency (security).

Reminders / personal todos:
- follow up with Samir on MP-218 patch status
- update marketplace partner playbook with SDK snippet (priority: high)
- record quick Loom for Partner B sign-up flow (5–7 min)

Open questions / TBD:
- Do we have a published SLA template for marketplace partners? (asked legal)
- Exact throughput expectations for Integrator Beta — need from partner product

Random notes to self (scratchy):
- consider adding 'auto-billing threshold' option on partner settings page for early pilots
- check whether dedicated customers can opt into pre-warmed cache (infra)

Links referenced:
- Jira: MP-218 (data residency)
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-integration/pull/91
- Confluence: marketplace-partner-playbook (draft)

End of notes.
